title: Hide absolute source checkout paths
decision: App-facing workspace metadata should not expose absolute local filesystem paths to the original EPP source checkout. The import may retain source kind, branch, commit, import timestamp, and a non-browseable human label such as Emergency Prep Project source repo.
context: The current import manifest records the original EPP repo path in source_reference.path. That is useful for developer debugging but should not be treated as app-facing workspace metadata or shown through future service responses.
rationale: Absolute local paths are machine- and user-specific, create noisy UI metadata, and can leak developer environment details. Branch and commit provenance keep the useful audit trail without exposing local filesystem structure.
alternatives_considered: Keep the absolute source repo path in workspace.json
Expose the path only in the app metadata inspector
consequences: SG-0007 should replace app-facing absolute source paths with non-browseable labels plus commit/branch provenance
The original EPP checkout path may remain an importer default or developer CLI argument, but not app-facing workspace metadata
SG-0013 service responses should not surface absolute local original-source checkout paths
The source-leak check should cover absolute local original-source checkout paths in app-facing metadata
